segments.text: 一对夫妻怕熊破坏院子里的围栏。
segments.verified_pinyin: yī duì fūqī pà xióng pòhuài yuànzǐ lǐ de wéilán
segments.translation_en: A couple were afraid that a bear would damage the fence in their yard.
So they installed a bear door.
At first, they were worried it would not work.

segments.text: 没想到这只熊非常的聪明。
segments.verified_pinyin: méi xiǎngdào zhè zhǐ xióng fēicháng de cōngmíng
segments.translation_en: But they did not expect the bear to be very smart.

segments.text: 这样一来，围栏不会坏了。
segments.verified_pinyin: zhèyàng yī lái, wéilán bù huì huàile
segments.translation_en: In this way, the fence would not be damaged.
And it became easier for the bear to walk.

segments.text: 夫妻俩非常喜欢这只熊。
segments.verified_pinyin: fūqī liǎ fēicháng xǐhuān zhè zhǐ xióng
segments.translation_en: The couple really liked this bear.
And they also paid attention to safety.
